name: Agitation
description: When carrying a survivor, you gain 18% Haste and your terror radius increases by 12 meters.

name: Brutal Strength
description: You break pallets and breakable walls with basic attacks, and damage generators 20% faster.

name: Unnerving Presence
description: Survivors within your terror radius get 10% more basic skill checks, but their good zone is 60% smaller.

name: Bloodhound
description: Blood pools are brighter and last 4 seconds longer.

name: Predator
description: When you stop chasing a survivor, you see their aura for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 40 seconds.

name: Shadowborn
description: Every time you are blinded, you gain 10% Haste for 10 seconds.

name: Enduring
description: While not carrying a survivor, pallet stuns are 50% shorter.

name: Lightborn
description: You cannot be blinded; every time a survivor tries, you see their aura for 10 seconds.

name: Tinkerer
description: The first time each generator reaches 70% progress, you gain Undetectable for 16 seconds and receive an alert.

name: Thanatophobia
description: For each injured, downed, or hooked survivor, everyone repairs, cleanses totems, and sabotages hooks 2% slower; with 4 survivors in that state, the effect becomes an extra 12% slower.

name: A Nurse's Calling
description: While within 32 meters of injured survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their aura.

name: Stridor
description: Survivors' breathing sounds are 25% louder, and their grunts of pain are increased by 50%.

name: Hex: Devour Hope
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; unhooking someone while you are 24 meters or more away grants you tokens (up to 5) that give Haste, expose survivors, and at 5 let you kill downed survivors.

name: Hex: Ruin
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; while a generator isn't being repaired, it regresses at 150% speed.

name: Hex: The Third Seal
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; damaging a survivor (up to 4) inflicts Blindness.

name: Overwhelming Presence
description: Using an item within 32 meters of you causes Exhausted for 15 seconds; seeing an Exhausted survivor nearby reveals their aura for 4 seconds (25s cooldown).

name: Monitor & Abuse
description: Your terror radius increases 15% while chasing, and shrinks 25% when not chasing anyone.

name: Overcharge
description: When you damage a generator, its regression rises from 85% to 130% for 30 seconds; the next survivor to repair it gets a special skill check, and failing it costs an extra 4% progress.

name: Barbecue & Chilli
description: When you hook a survivor, for 5 seconds you see the aura of everyone within 40 meters of the hook.

name: Knock Out
description: If a survivor comes within 6 meters of a pallet they dropped, they suffer 5% Hindered for 5 seconds (6s window).

name: Franklin's Demise
description: Damaging with a basic attack makes the survivor drop their item; you see the aura of dropped items within a 64-meter radius.

name: Beast of Prey
description: Gaining Bloodlust grants you Undetectable for 40 seconds.

name: Hex: Huntress's Lullaby
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; every hook grants a token that delays skill check warnings and shrinks their success zones; at 5, warnings disappear and failing a check costs an extra 6% progress.

name: Territorial Imperative
description: If a survivor enters the basement while you are 24 meters away, you see their aura for 6 seconds (45s cooldown).

name: Blood Warden
description: Once per trial, hooking someone after an exit gate has been opened blocks both gates for 60 seconds and reveals the aura of survivors near the exit thresholds.

name: Fire Up
description: Each completed generator grants 1 token (max 5); for each one, you break pallets, damage generators, carry survivors, and vault windows 6% faster.

name: Remember Me
description: Damaging the obsession grants 1 token (max 5); for each, non-obsession survivors open exit gates 30% slower.

name: Hangman's Trick
description: At the start, 4 random hooks become scourge hooks; carrying someone reveals auras near them, and you get alerted if one is being sabotaged.

name: Surveillance
description: You see the aura of regressing generators (for 16s after repair stops) and hear their repair from 8 meters.

name: Make Your Choice
description: Self-unhooking or unhooking another while you are within 32 meters makes the survivor scream and suffer Exposed for 60 seconds (60s cooldown).

name: Coulrophobia
description: Survivors within your terror radius heal 50% slower and their healing skill checks rotate 50% faster.

name: Pop Goes the Weasel
description: After hooking someone, for the next 45 seconds any generator you damage explodes and loses 15% more progress.

name: Bamboozle
description: Every window vault blocks it for survivors for 16 seconds (only one at a time); your basic vaults are 15% faster.

name: Spirit Fury
description: After breaking 2 pallets, the next one that stuns you is destroyed.

name: Hex: Haunted Ground
description: 2 dull totems ignite at the start; blessing or cleansing either one gives all survivors Exposed for 60 seconds and snuffs out the other totem.

name: Rancor
description: Every completed generator alerts you to everyone's location for 3 seconds and the obsession sees your aura for 3s; once all generators are done, the obsession becomes Exposed and can be mori'd.

name: Discordance
description: If 2 or more survivors repair the same generator within a 128-meter radius, you get an alert and see its aura while they do (fades 4s after they stop).

name: Mad Grit
description: While carrying someone, missing a basic attack reduces your cooldown by 100%, and hitting the carried survivor with a basic attack blocks their wiggle progress for 4 seconds.

name: Iron Maiden
description: Leaving a locker exposes the survivor for 30 seconds, makes them scream, and reveals their location for 4s; you open lockers 50% faster.

name: Corrupt Intervention
description: At the start, the 3 generators farthest from you are blocked for 120 seconds or until you down someone.

name: Infectious Fright
description: When you down a survivor, everyone within your terror radius screams and alerts you to their location for 6 seconds.

name: Dark Devotion
description: Damaging the obsession makes you transfer your terror radius (set to 40m) to them and turns you Undetectable for 45 seconds.

name: I’m All Ears
description: You see the aura of a survivor sprinting into or out of a locker, or performing a medium/fast vault within 48 meters, for 8 seconds (30s cooldown).

name: Thrilling Tremors
description: Picking up a survivor blocks all unrepaired generators for 16 seconds (30s cooldown).

name: Furtive Chase
description: Hooking the obsession grants 10% Haste and Undetectable for 18 seconds; whoever unhooks them becomes the new obsession.

name: Surge
description: Downing someone with a basic attack makes generators within 32 meters explode, lose 8% progress, start regressing, and make anyone repairing them scream.

name: Cruel Limits
description: While survivors repair a generator, they suffer Blindness and Exhausted (ends 5s after they stop repairing).

name: Mindbreaker
description: When a generator is completed, you see the aura of every window and they are blocked for survivors for 30 seconds.

name: Zanshin Tactics
description: You see the aura of pallets and windows within 32 meters; if a survivor drops a pallet, you see its aura for 5 seconds.

name: Blood Echo
description: Hooking someone gives every injured survivor Exhausted and Hemorrhage for 30 seconds.

name: Nemesis
description: Blinding you or stunning you with a locker or pallet makes the survivor the obsession, who suffers Oblivious for 60 seconds and reveals their aura for 8s.

name: Gearhead
description: After damaging a survivor, for 30 seconds every good repair skill check reveals the aura of whoever made it for 8 seconds.

name: Dead Man's Switch
description: When you hook someone, the first survivor to stop repairing a generator blocks it for 35 seconds (35s cooldown).

name: Hex: Retribution
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; blessing or cleansing a totem inflicts Oblivious for 60 seconds on whoever tries, and succeeding reveals everyone’s aura for 20s.

name: Forced Penance
description: A survivor who takes a protection hit suffers Broken for 80 seconds.

name: Trail of Torment
description: Damaging a generator grants you Undetectable and reveals its aura to survivors until it stops regressing (30s cooldown).

name: Deathbound
description: When a survivor finishes healing another, they scream; until they take damage, being within 4 meters or more of who healed them inflicts Oblivious and reveals their aura.

name: Dragon's Grip
description: When you damage a generator, for the next 30 seconds whoever repairs it first screams, reveals their location for 4s, and suffers Exposed for 60s (30s cooldown).

name: Hex: Undying
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; if another hex totem is blessed or cleansed, this one replaces it keeping its tokens; you see the aura of survivors near dull totems within 4 meters.

name: Hex: Blood Favor
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; damaging a survivor blocks upright pallets within 32 meters for 15 seconds.

name: Hoarder
description: Two extra chests appear at the start; you get alerted if someone picks up an item or opens a chest within 64 meters.

name: Oppression
description: Damaging a generator makes up to 4 others start regressing and gives whoever repairs them a special skill check (35s cooldown).

name: Coup de Grâce
description: Each completed generator grants 2 tokens (max 5); spend 1 while charging to extend it by 80%.

name: Starstruck
description: While carrying someone, survivors within your terror radius suffer Exposed, lasting 30 seconds after leaving the radius or after you drop/hook the carried survivor (60s cooldown).

name: Hex: Crowd Control
description: The first time survivors vault a window at medium/fast speed, a dull totem ignites; the last 6 windows used that way get blocked, you vault them 15% faster, and see their aura within 24 meters.

name: No Way Out
description: The first hook on each survivor grants 1 token; once all generators are done, starting to open an exit gate blocks it for 12 seconds plus 12s per token, and you get an alert.

name: Lethal Pursuer
description: At the start you see every survivor's aura for 9 seconds; every time you see a survivor's aura for a duration, it's extended by 2 seconds.

name: Hysteria
description: When an unharmed survivor is injured, every injured survivor suffers Oblivious for 40 seconds (20s cooldown).

name: Eruption
description: Damaging a generator and then downing someone makes every generator explode, lose 10% progress, start regressing, and makes anyone repairing them scream and reveal their aura for 12s (30s cooldown).

name: Grim Embrace
description: Each survivor's first hook grants 1 token; moving 16 meters away from a hooked survivor blocks all generators for 10s, and at 4 tokens, for 40s more and you see your obsession's aura for 10s.

name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
description: At the start, 4 hooks become scourge hooks and you gain 4 tokens; the first hook on one spends a token to explode the generator with the most progress, which loses 20% and starts regressing while whoever repairs it screams.

name: Hex: Pentimento
description: You see the aura of cleansed totems and can reignite each one once; survivors within 16m see reignited totem auras and heal/repair 20% slower (+3% per extra one); if all 5 are reignited at once, they become blocked.

name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
description: At the start, 4 random hooks become scourge hooks; unhooking someone from one reveals the aura of other survivors for 7 seconds.

name: Call of Brine
description: Damaging a generator makes it regress 50% faster for 70 seconds; during that time, good repair skill checks on it alert you.

name: Merciless Storm
description: The first time each generator reaches 90%, whoever repairs it gets special skill checks; failing one or stopping repairs blocks it for 20 seconds.

name: Dissolution
description: Three seconds after a survivor takes damage, for 20s the next pallet fast-vaulted within your terror radius is destroyed.

name: Darkness Revealed
description: Checking a locker reveals the aura of survivors within 8 meters of lockers for 8 seconds (30s cooldown).

name: Septic Touch
description: A survivor healing within your terror radius suffers Blindness and Exhausted (ends 30s after they stop healing).

name: Superior Anatomy
description: If a survivor fast-vaults within 12 meters of you, your next window vault is 40% faster (25s cooldown).

name: Awakened Awareness
description: While carrying a survivor, you see the aura of other survivors within 20 meters.

name: Terminus
description: When all generators are completed, injured, downed, and hooked survivors suffer Broken until 45 seconds after an exit gate opens.

name: Nowhere to Hide
description: Damaging a generator reveals the aura of survivors within 24 meters or less for 5 seconds.

name: Hex: Face the Darkness
description: Damaging a survivor curses them and ignites a dull totem; every 25s, other survivors outside your terror radius scream and you see their aura for 2s; the curse ends if the marked survivor is downed or heals.

name: Hubris
description: A survivor who stuns you suffers Exposed for 30 seconds (20s cooldown).

name: Game Afoot
description: While chasing your obsession, breaking pallets/walls or damaging generators grants 7% Haste for 10s; damaging the survivor with the most chase time with a basic attack makes them the new obsession.

name: THWACK!
description: You start with 3 tokens (max 3, +1 per hook); spend 1 when breaking a pallet or wall to make survivors within 36 meters scream and reveal their aura for 6s.

name: Leverage
description: Self-unhooking or unhooking another makes that survivor heal 30% slower for 60 seconds.

name: Genetic Limits
description: A survivor who takes damage suffers Exhausted for 8 seconds.

name: Forced Hesitation
description: Downing someone gives others within 16 meters of the downed survivor 20% Hindered for 10s (30s cooldown).

name: Machine Learning
description: Damaging a generator compromises it; when survivors complete it, you gain 8% Haste and Undetectable for 60s (only one compromised at a time).

name: Ultimate Weapon
description: Checking a locker makes survivors within 40 meters suffer Blindness for 30 seconds and scream (45s cooldown).

name: Rapid Brutality
description: Damaging with a basic attack grants 5% Haste for 10 seconds; while chasing, you can't gain Bloodlust.

name: Alien Instinct
description: Hooking someone makes the farthest injured survivor suffer Oblivious for 60 seconds and reveals their aura for 8s.

name: Hex: Two Can Play
description: While this hex isn't active, being blinded or stunned twice ignites a dull totem; blinding or stunning you while you aren't carrying anyone inflicts Blindness for 1.5s on whoever did it.

name: Friends 'Til the End
description: Hooking someone who isn’t the obsession exposes the obsession for 20s and reveals their aura for 10s; hooking the obsession makes another survivor scream, alerts you, and makes them the new obsession.

name: Batteries Included
description: Within 16 meters of a completed generator you gain 5% Haste (ends 5s after leaving the radius).

name: Unbound
description: When an unharmed survivor is injured, for the next 30s your basic window vaults grant 7% Haste for 10s.

name: Unforeseen
description: Damaging a generator sets your terror radius to it (32m) and grants Undetectable for 30 seconds (30s cooldown).

name: Undone
description: Failing a skill check grants 3 tokens (max 30); damaging a generator spends them all: it loses 1% progress and blocks for 1s per token, then starts regressing once unblocked (60s cooldown).

name: Weave Attunement
description: The first time an item depletes, it drops to the ground; both of you see auras near it, and whoever picks it up suffers Oblivious for 30s.

name: Languid Touch
description: Startling a crow within 36 meters of you inflicts Exhausted for 10 seconds (5s cooldown).

name: Dark Arrogance
description: You vault windows 25% faster; if you are blinded or pallet-stunned, the duration increases by 15%.

name: Hex: Wretched Fate
description: A dull totem ignites when the first generator is completed; the obsession repairs 33% slower and sees the totem’s aura within 12 meters.

name: Human Greed
description: You see the aura of survivors within 8 meters of locked chests for 5s; you can lock chests (10s cooldown) and see the aura of locked ones.

name: Dominance
description: Each survivor's first unlocked chest and cleansed/blessed totem gets blocked for 16 seconds.

name: All-Shaking Thunder
description: Falling 1.2 meters or more makes your next lunges 75% longer for 25s (5s cooldown).

name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
description: At the start, 4 random hooks become scourge hooks (and any hook someone is unhooked from becomes one too); hooking on one reveals the aura of the generator with the most progress for 10s.

name: No Quarter
description: While self-healing and reaching 75% progress, the survivor gets special skill checks; failing one or stopping inflicts Broken for 30 seconds.

name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
description: After damaging survivors with basic attacks 8 times, a dull totem ignites; damaging a survivor with a basic attack inflicts 5% Hindered for 15s.

name: Forever Entwined
description: Taking damage grants 1 token (max 8); for each, you hook, carry, and down survivors 4% faster.

name: None Are Free
description: Each survivor's first hook grants 1 token; once all generators are done, pallets and windows are blocked for 16s per token.

name: Help Wanted
description: Damaging a generator compromises it; when survivors complete it, your basic attack cooldown is 25% shorter for 60s (only one compromised at a time).

name: Phantom Fear
description: A survivor who looks at you within your terror radius screams and reveals their aura for 2 seconds (60s cooldown).

name: Haywire
description: Exit gates at 80% progress or more revert to 100% speed, their lights flickering at random.

name: Ravenous
description: Each survivor's first hook grants 1 token; at 4, everyone screams and suffers Exposed for 60 seconds.

name: Wandering Eye
description: While chasing someone, for 5s you see the aura of other injured survivors within 20 meters (30s cooldown).

name: Hex: Overture of Doom
description: A dull totem ignites at the start and curses the farthest generator; after 5s of repairing it, you gain Undetectable for 30s with your radius set to it, then the curse moves to the next farthest generator.

name: Turn Back the Clock
description: After hooking someone, for the next 60s you can detonate a generator you can see within 20 meters, making it lose 10% progress and start regressing.

name: Secret Project
description: Blessing or cleansing a totem blocks a random unblocked generator for 30s; while one is blocked, you gain Undetectable for 30s.

name: Hex: Hive Mind
description: The first hook ignites a dull totem; generator auras show their progress, and once only 1 remains, all others explode, lose 10% progress, start regressing, and the totem snuffs out.

name: Hex: Scared to Death
description: After hooking 3 different survivors, a dull totem ignites; while chasing, breaking a pallet makes survivors within 13 meters scream and suffer 13% Hindered for 3s.

name: Silent Shadow
description: Every hook grants Undetectable for 13 seconds; once all generators are done, you gain Undetectable.

name: Rampage
description: Breaking pallets or walls grants 1 token (max 13); when blinded or pallet-stunned, for 13s you gain 1% Haste per token (20s cooldown).

name: Deerstalker
description: Every 30 seconds, the survivor with the least chase time sees your aura for 3s; while a survivor sees your aura, you see theirs too.

name: Iron Grasp
description: While carrying someone, their struggle is 12% slower and 75% weaker.

name: Sloppy Butcher
description: Damaging with a basic attack inflicts Hemorrhage and Mangled for 90s; while Hemorrhaging, healing progress is lost 25% faster.

name: Distressing
description: Your terror radius increases by 30%.

name: Shattered Hope
description: Snuffing a boon totem reveals the aura of survivors nearby for 8s and destroys it.

name: Spies from the Shadows
description: If a survivor startles a crow within 36 meters, you get an alert (5s cooldown).

name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
description: At the start, 4 hooks become scourge hooks; unhooking from one inflicts Hemorrhage and Mangled for 90s, and until they take damage, healing and repairing are 16% slower.

name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
description: Each survivor's first hook curses them and ignites a dull totem (blocked for others for 90s); cursed survivors suffer Oblivious and see the totem's aura within 16 meters.

name: Deadlock
description: When a generator is completed, the one with the most progress is blocked for 25 seconds.

name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
description: At the start, 4 random hooks and the basement hooks become scourge hooks; sacrificing someone within 24 meters of one is 20% faster.

name: Unrelenting
description: Missing a basic attack reduces your cooldown by 30%.

name: Insidious
description: After standing still for 1 second, you gain Undetectable until you act.

name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
description: A dull totem ignites at the start; for each remaining dull and hex totem you gain a token, and for each one, survivors cleanse and bless totems 12% slower.

name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
description: When all generators are completed, a dull totem ignites: survivors suffer Exposed and you gain 4% Haste; they see the totem’s aura within 4 meters, expanding to 24 over 30s.

name: Play With Your Food
description: Stopping a chase with the obsession grants 1 token (max 3, 10s cooldown); each token grants 5% Haste, but attacking spends 1.

name: Save the Best for Last
description: Damaging a non-obsession survivor with a basic attack grants 1 token (max 8) that reduces your basic attack cooldown 4% each; damaging the obsession removes 2, and you gain none while they are dead.

name: Dying Light
description: Hooking a non-obsession survivor grants 1 token; while the obsession is alive, for each token others heal, repair, and sabotage 3% slower, while the obsession does those 33% faster.

name: Bitter Murmur
description: When a generator is completed, you see the aura of survivors within 16 meters of it for 5s; when all are completed, you see everyone’s aura for 10s.

name: Whispers
description: Within 32 meters of a survivor, you hear random whispers.
